# Generated by @react-native/codegen (library FBReactNativeSpec,
# platform android generators componentsAndroid + modulesCxx) and
# adapted for the gpui platform.
#
# Difference vs. the generated file: the JNI module implementation
# (FBReactNativeSpec-generated.cpp, generated by the modulesAndroid
# generator) is Android-only and is not built here. Its job — the
# FBReactNativeSpec_ModuleProvider definition and the Native*SpecJSI
# constructors — is supplied by the platform layer (ReactCxxPlatform
# core modules and the gpui host, TODOs 1.5+). The component
# descriptors and the C++ spec headers are platform-independent.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE on)

file(GLOB react_codegen_SRCS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
     react/renderer/components/FBReactNativeSpec/*.cpp)

add_library(
  react_codegen_rncore
  OBJECT
  ${react_codegen_SRCS}
)

target_include_directories(react_codegen_rncore PUBLIC . react/renderer/components/FBReactNativeSpec react/renderer/components)

target_link_libraries(
  react_codegen_rncore
  jsi
  # We need to link different libraries based on whether we are building rncore or not, that's necessary
  # because we want to break a circular dependency between react_codegen_rncore and reactnative
  folly_runtime glog react_debug react_nativemodule_core react_renderer_componentregistry react_renderer_core react_renderer_debug react_renderer_graphics react_renderer_imagemanager react_renderer_mapbuffer react_utils rrc_image rrc_view yoga
)

target_compile_reactnative_options(react_codegen_rncore PRIVATE)
